connections.reason: STANAG 4609 full motion video over UDP, unicast or multicast, as each link in the settings names it. An input link receives from cameras, usually on a UAV, and binds to loopback unless an admin sets another address; a multicast link joins its group on the interface an admin names. An output link sends a simulated camera's video, paced, to the address or group an admin sets; a new output link has none and sends nothing. The addresses, groups, interfaces and ports come only from the links.

internet.reason: The output links' cameras may see imagery from a WMS an admin names in the WMS imagery settings, for the area the imagery folder does not cover. No host is contacted by default; the host comes only from that setting, and the tiles are kept so that a flown area works offline.

links.title: Links
links.description: The FMV links, one entry per link: each receives STANAG 4609 full motion video over UDP and writes the camera and its field of view into a layer. Without an entry the plugin does nothing. The form shows the fields the link's mode uses.

x-emc2.hint: Each link receives or sends STANAG 4609 over UDP

groups.label: Connection
groups.description: In: where the link listens. Out: where it sends; a new output link has no destination and sends nothing until one is set.

groups.label: Video
groups.description: Out: the simulated camera's H.264 video, its metadata and the pacing.

groups.label: Picture
groups.description: In: where and how the camera and its field of view are drawn. Out: what the simulated camera sees.

groups.label: Classification
groups.description: Labels and ST 0102: in, from the stream to the objects; out, from the camera's label to the stream, with its release limit.

groups.label: Advanced
groups.description: In: which clock the objects follow, and when the panel says Stale.

id.description: The link's stable id (a UUID v7): ECore fills it in, nothing changes it, and it is not shown. A renamed link keeps its objects by it.

name.description: The link's name, 1 to 64 characters (e.g. FMV link 1). It names the link's objects; renaming the link keeps them.

x-emc2.hint: Renaming the link keeps its objects

name.title: Name

enabled.description: Whether the plugin runs this link. Stopping it keeps its objects.
enabled.title: Enabled

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: in: receives STANAG 4609 and draws the camera and its field of view. out: offers an output channel that takes a simulated camera's poses and sends its video as STANAG 4609.

x-emc2.hint: in: receives and draws; out: sends a simulated camera's video

mode.description: udp: unicast to or from an address and port. multicast: an input link joins the group on the interface an administrator names; an output link sends to the group from that interface.

x-emc2.hint: udp: unicast; multicast: joins a group on a named interface

mode.title: Mode

address.description: udp in: the local address to listen on; absent, 127.0.0.1 (only this computer); 0.0.0.0 listens on the network. udp out: where to send; absent, nothing is sent.

x-emc2.hint: In: absent is 127.0.0.1; out: where to send

address.title: Address

group.description: multicast: the group, 224.0.0.0 to 239.255.255.255. An input link joins it; an output link sends to it.
group.title: Group

interface.description: multicast: the network interface, by name or address, that joins the group or sends to it. Required with a group: without one the link stays stopped.

x-emc2.hint: Required for multicast: the interface, by name or address

interface.title: Interface

port.description: in: the port to listen on. out: the port to send to; absent, nothing is sent.
port.title: Port

ttl.title: Multicast TTL
ttl.description: out, multicast: how many routers the datagrams may cross, 1 to 32. 1 keeps them on the local network.

x-emc2.hint: 1: the local network only

targetLayer.description: Where the camera and its field of view go: an existing layer, or "New layer" with a name. Absent: a new layer named like the link.

x-emc2.hint: Empty: a new layer named like the link

targetLayer.title: Layer

cameraSymbol.description: The camera's APP-6D symbol code (20 digits); its context is reality and its identity follows the setting below. Default: a UAV with photographic reconnaissance.

x-emc2.hint: A 20-digit APP-6D code

cameraSymbol.title: Camera symbol

cameraIdentity.description: The standard identity of the camera's symbol.

x-emc2.hint: The standard identity of the camera's symbol

cameraIdentity.title: Camera identity

fovColour.description: The colour of the field of view's line, #RRGGBB.

x-emc2.hint: The field of view's line

fovColour.title: Field of view colour

label.description: The label of the link's layer, and of objects whose stream's classification is not mapped. Default: the server's default label.

x-emc2.hint: The layer's label, and an object's when the stream's is not mapped

classification.description: The classification the policy defines, e.g. UNCLASSIFIED.
classification.title: Classification

label.title: Label

classification.description: map gives the objects and the stream the classification of ST 0102 tag 1, named by the names below; link-label gives them the link's label.

x-emc2.hint: map: the stream's classification by the names below; link-label: the link's

classification.title: Classification

classificationNames.description: The policy's classifications for ST 0102's classification 1 (unclassified) to 5 (top secret). In: names the stream's classification. Out: gives a pose's label its number. Default: NATO's.

x-emc2.hint: The names of classifications 1 (unclassified) to 5 (top secret)

classificationNames.title: Classification names

time.description: received uses the server's clock when each set arrived (for replays of old recordings); stream uses the time stamp in the set (ST 0601 tag 2).

x-emc2.hint: received: the server's clock; stream: the set's own time stamp

time.title: Time

staleSeconds.description: After this long without a metadata set the panel says Stale; the objects stay.

x-emc2.hint: Without a set for this long the panel says Stale

staleSeconds.title: Stale after

bitrate.title: Bit rate
bitrate.description: out: the H.264 video's bit rate, 0.5 to 20 Mbit/s.

keyframeSeconds.title: Keyframe every
keyframeSeconds.description: out: the time between keyframes, 0.5 to 10 s: where a new viewer can start.

metadataEvery.title: Metadata every
metadataEvery.description: out: an ST 0601 set with every Nth frame, 1 to 25; 1 sends one with every frame.

maxRate.title: Pacing rate
maxRate.description: out: the most the link sends, 1 to 50 Mbit/s. Datagrams are paced to it, so that a keyframe never leaves as one burst a receiver drops.

x-emc2.hint: The most the link sends; paced, so a keyframe never leaves in one burst

bitErrors.title: Bit errors
bitErrors.description: out: a poor radio link, as a receiver shows it. Every so often a few runs of 16 × 16 blocks of the picture go wrong, as where a decoder lost part of a picture: they show the last picture from the wrong place and smear, or turn flat green, until the next keyframe. The blocks are drawn into the picture before it is encoded, so every player shows them; the stream and its KLV are never damaged. Off by default. A change applies from the next picture.

x-emc2.hint: Wrong blocks until the next keyframe, every 15 ± 3 s by default

enabled.title: Add bit errors
enabled.description: On: the picture gets bit errors as set below. Off: the picture as rendered.

every.title: Every
every.description: The mean time between two error events, 2 to 600 s of the video's time.

x-emc2.hint: The mean time between two events

jitter.title: Give or take
jitter.description: How far an event may fall either side of the mean time, 0 to 60 s and less than Every.

x-emc2.hint: Less than Every

blocks.title: Runs per event
blocks.description: How many runs of 16 × 16 blocks an event damages, 1 to 20: each from a random block on, along its row and into the next, like a lost slice.

x-emc2.hint: Each a run of blocks along a row

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The random generator's seed, 0 to 2147483647: the same seed gives the same events from the same start.

x-emc2.hint: The same seed gives the same events

sampling.title: Sampling
sampling.description: out: how the picture samples the imagery. bilinear is smoother; nearest is faster.

x-emc2.hint: bilinear: smoother; nearest: faster

haze.title: Haze
haze.description: out: haze that grows with distance, to 60 % at 25 km. The degraded camera, while on, uses its own grey haze instead.

degraded.title: Degraded camera
degraded.description: out: the picture of a cheap sensor over a low-bitrate downlink: a grey haze that grows with distance, less contrast and colour, a softer picture drawn at half the resolution, and sensor noise. While it is on, its grey haze is used instead of Haze. A change applies from the next frame.

x-emc2.hint: A cheap sensor: grey haze, softer, less colour, noise

enabled.title: Degrade the picture
enabled.description: On: the camera draws the degraded picture. Off: the picture as the settings above draw it.

haze.title: Grey haze
haze.description: The grey haze at its strongest, 0 to 100 %: at 4 km a pixel has about two thirds of it, and far away all of it. The sky goes the same share towards the grey.

x-emc2.hint: At 4 km about two thirds of it

noise.title: Sensor noise
noise.description: The sensor noise, 0 to 100 %: at 100 % a pixel swings by up to 24 luma levels, new in every frame. More noise also costs the encoder more of its bit rate.

x-emc2.hint: New in every frame; more noise, blockier video

imagerySet.title: Imagery set
imagerySet.description: out: the name of the imagery set the camera sees, a subfolder of the imagery folder. Empty: the first set that covers the camera.

x-emc2.hint: Empty: the first set that covers the camera

highestClassification.title: Highest classification
highestClassification.description: out: a camera whose platform's label is above it is not rendered or sent, and is counted. Absent: the classification of the server's default label (ADR-0037).

x-emc2.hint: A camera above it is not sent; empty: the default label's

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: The classification the policy defines, e.g. RESTRICTED.

classifyingCountry.title: Classifying country
classifyingCountry.description: out: ST 0102's classifying country, // and 1 to 4 letters, e.g. //NATO or //SWE.

imageryFolder.title: Imagery folder
imageryFolder.description: The folder of orthophoto sets the output links' cameras see: one subfolder per set, each with an imagery.json (its name, source, licence, CRS and tiles) and its JPEG or PNG tiles. %emcc%/ is the folder emcc runs from. Read only; nothing outside it is read.

x-emc2.hint: Orthophoto sets, one subfolder each with an imagery.json

terrainFolder.title: Terrain folder
terrainFolder.description: The DTED height data (levels 0 to 2, e<lon>/n<lat>.dt<n>) the output links' cameras see the imagery draped over; by default the terrain plugin's folder. Where no height data covers a point the ground is flat at 0 m. Read only.

x-emc2.hint: DTED levels 0 to 2; empty ground is flat at 0 m

wms.title: WMS imagery
wms.description: Imagery for the output links' cameras from a WMS 1.3.0 server, where the imagery folder has none: tiles within 2 km of where a camera looks, fetched at most 4 at a time and 20 a second, and kept (at most 900 tiles) so that a flown area works offline. Nothing is fetched without a source and a licence. The video carries the imagery onward, so its terms decide where the video may go.

x-emc2.hint: Off by default; tiles where the imagery folder has none

enabled.title: Fetch from a WMS
enabled.description: On: the cameras fetch the tiles the imagery folder lacks from the WMS below. Off: no request is made; tiles already kept are still used.

x-emc2.hint: Off: no request is made; the tiles already kept are still used

url.title: Server
url.description: The WMS server's address, http or https, without the request's parameters or a user name, e.g. https://example.org/wms. Only this setting names the host.

x-emc2.hint: http or https, without parameters

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: The WMS layer's name, as GetCapabilities lists it.

crs.title: CRS
crs.description: The tiles' coordinate system: EPSG:3006 (SWEREF 99 TM) or EPSG:4326 (WGS84). The server must offer it for the layer.

x-emc2.hint: The server must offer it for the layer

format.title: Format
format.description: The tiles' image format: image/jpeg is smaller, image/png is lossless.

tilePixels.title: Tile size
tilePixels.description: The width and height of one tile in pixels.

metresPerPixel.title: Ground resolution
metresPerPixel.description: Metres on the ground per pixel, 0.25 to 10. In EPSG:4326 a pixel is this many metres of latitude, and the same angle of longitude.

x-emc2.hint: Metres on the ground per pixel, 0.25 to 10

source.title: Source
source.description: Who made the imagery, e.g. Lantmäteriet. Required to fetch; shown in the Monitor with the licence.

x-emc2.hint: Who made the imagery, e.g. Lantmäteriet; required to fetch

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: The imagery's licence or terms, e.g. CC0-1.0. Required to fetch: the video carries the imagery onward, so its terms decide where the video may go.

x-emc2.hint: The imagery's terms, e.g. CC0-1.0; required to fetch

token.title: Access token
token.description: The name of an access token in the server's credentials (emc2.http.credentials.<name>.token), sent as Authorization: Bearer. Empty: none. The token itself is never a setting.

x-emc2.hint: A token's name in the server's credentials; empty: none
